vid_urls.title: U.S. Spacewalk 96
vid_urls.description:
At approximately 8:35 a.m. EDT (1235 UTC) on Aug. 6, 2026, NASA astronauts Anil Menon and Jessica Meir will venture outside the International Space Station for an approximately six-and-a-half-hour spacewalk. The pair will install hardware that will modify the station’s 3B power channel and prepare it for the future installation of an International Space Station Roll-Out Solar Array.

This spacewalk will be the first for Menon and the sixth for Meir. Meir will serve as spacewalk crew member 1 and will wear a suit with red stripes. Menon will serve as crew member 2 and will wear an unmarked suit.

Learn more about this spacewalk: https://go.nasa.gov/4x9ASdi
Read the latest mission updates from the station: https://nasa.gov/blogs/spacestation/

Credit: NASA

info_urls.title: Astronaut Chris Williams to Discuss Space Station Mission
info_urls.description: NASA astronaut Chris Williams will recap his recent eight-month mission aboard the International Space Station during a news conference at 2:45 p.m. EDT

vid_urls.title: NASA Astronaut Chris Williams Postflight News Conference (Aug. 4, 2026)
vid_urls.description:
Tune in as astronaut Chris Williams recaps his eight-month mission aboard the International Space Station. 

After logging 241 days aboard the orbital laboratory, Williams returned to Earth on July 26, 2026. During his mission, he contributed to a wide range of scientific investigations and technology demonstrations, including research on new cancer treatments and manufacturing materials used in high-performance computers and electronics.
 
Learn more about the science Williams conducted: https://go.nasa.gov/4fjNCry
Learn more about the International Space Station: https://www.nasa.gov/station

Credit: NASA
